subject: general
question:
In the following passage, some words have been deleted. Read the passage carefully and select the most appropriate option to fill in the blanks.

Cuba is known as the sugar bowl of the world. It is part of the Caribbean ____________. This country ______________ a lot of sugar in the decade of 1960s.
solution:
The correct answer is '**Option 2**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Cuba is known as the sugar bowl of the world due to its significant sugar production.
 
• The word "**region**" refers to a specific geographical area, which fits the context of Cuba being part of the Caribbean.
 
• The word "**produced**" accurately describes the country's sugar output during the decade of 1960s.
 
• Other options like "**sector; created**," "**stretch; processed**," and "**area; cropped**" do not fit the context as appropriately.

​Therefore, the correct answer is '**Option 2**'.

**Complete Sentence:** *Cuba is known as the sugar bowl of the world. It is part of the Caribbean region__. This country __produced__ a lot of sugar in the decade of 1960s.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Sector (क्षेत्र)**: refers to a part of an area or industry, but does not fit the geographical reference.
 
• **Stretch (खंड)**: refers to a continuous area or length, which is not suitable in this context.
 
• **Area (क्षेत्र)**: a general term for a place, but "region" is more specific.
 
• **Created (निर्मित)**: does not describe sugar production appropriately.
 
• **Processed (प्रसंस्कृत)**: refers to refining or treating, which is not relevant here.
 
• **Cropped (उगाया)**: refers to cultivation, but "produced" is a better fit for the context.
